[EN] More Bubbles
[ES] Más burbujas
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Head northwest, and you'll find the grellem spires.
[ES] Dirígete al noroeste y encontrarás las agujas grellem.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You don't have to worry.
[ES] No tienes de qué preocuparte.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Break the {@creature:45#7003#grellem spires} in the northwestern swamp of the {@Rgn:45003$$Vale of the Reaper} and collect shards.
[ES] Destruye las {@creature:45#7003#grellem spires} en el pantano del noroeste del {@Rgn:45003$$Vale of the Reaper} y recolecta fragmentos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Intruder! Intruder!
[ES] ¡Intruso! ¡Intruso!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill the {@creature:45#6001#argonomorph tuwangi frogmaster} in the far northwest of the {@Rgn:45003$$Vale of the Reaper}.
[ES] Mata al {@creature:45#6001#argonomorph tuwangi frogmaster} en el extremo noroeste del {@Rgn:45003$$Vale of the Reaper}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation."
[ES] "Por la federación."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect controller shards.
[ES] Recolecta fragmentos de controlador.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the shards to {@LinkCreature:245#1013$$Chaxanaz} at {@Rgn:45007$$Field Base Tenacity}.
[ES] Entrega los fragmentos a {@LinkCreature:245#1013$$Chaxanaz} en {@Rgn:45007$$Field Base Tenacity}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
